buffer: 50 mM potassium phosphate, 50 mM NaCl, 10% (vol/vol) D2O, 0.2 mM DSS
construct_or_mutation: FtsX ECL1 (residues 46 to 168), S. pneumoniae D39, 15N- or 15N,13C-labeled; 400 uM for dynamics experiments
experiment: 15N-{1H} hNOE, R1/R2 (R2/R1 ratio) and CPMG relaxation dispersion (Rex) at 600 and 800 MHz
other_conditions: regime (authors): ms timescale conformational exchange for beta1-beta2 linker and beta-hairpin; fast sub-ns motion for alpha2-beta5 linker, beta-hairpin and termini; Rex at 600 and 800 MHz plotted in Fig. S3I (values not in text); related structures: 6MK7 (NMR ensemble), 6HE6, 6HEE, 6HFX (crystal)
author_claim: The central core is well defined; the beta-hairpin (residues 71 to 87) and the helical lobe (residues 107 to 135) are dynamic: the beta-hairpin on both sub-ns and ms timescales, the alpha2-beta5 linker on fast timescales, the beta1-beta2 linker with ms exchange.
anchor: These findings were directly confirmed by Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill (CPMG) relaxation dispersion NMR spectroscopy ( Fig. S3 I and J) ( 31 ).
locator: Results, FtsX ECL1 is dynamic in solution (Fig. S3E-J); conditions: Materials and Methods, NMR spectroscopy
caveat_note: Temperature, pH, field (600/800 MHz) and buffer match the entry card. Rex, hNOE and R2/R1 values appear only in Fig. S3 plots (no numeric table in the text); no exchange rates, populations or residue lists are given, so the regions are named only by secondary-structure element. Phosphate buffer is not relevant to this unliganded protein.

buffer: 50 mM potassium phosphate, 50 mM NaCl, 10% (vol/vol) D2O, 0.2 mM DSS
construct_or_mutation: FtsX ECL1 (residues 46 to 168), S. pneumoniae D39, 15N- or 15N,13C-labeled; 400 uM for dynamics experiments
experiment: 1D(HN) residual dipolar couplings from 2D IPAP 15N,1H-HSQC, aligned in 20 mg/ml Pf1 phage vs isotropic sample; back-calculation with PALES
ligand_or_partner: Pf1 filamentous phage (20 mg/ml) as alignment medium
other_conditions: 82 RDCs used, 112 measured (Table 1); Q factor 0.11 (0.39); correlation 0.99 (0.89); hypermobile regions with vanishing RDCs: residues 45 to 58, 119 to 133, 165 to 168 (Fig. S3 legend); related structures: 6MK7, 6HE6, 6HEE, 6HFX
author_claim: RDCs near 0 for the N-terminal tail, the C terminus and the nonhelical part of the helical lobe between alpha2 and beta5 indicate significant conformational disorder in solution; experimental and back-calculated RDCs match only in the core subdomain, and poorly in the beta-hairpin for most crystal structures.
anchor: In contrast, 1 D HN values near 0 for the N-terminal tail, the very C terminus, and the nonhelical part of the helical lobe between α2 and β5 are suggestive of significant conformational disorder in solution
locator: Results, FtsX ECL1 is dynamic in solution (Fig. S3A-D); conditions: Materials and Methods, NMR spectroscopy; Table 1
caveat_note: The number of measured RDCs differs between the main-text Table 1 (112) and the supplemental methods text (121). Vanishing RDCs show orientational averaging but do not by themselves give a timescale. The deposited ensemble (6MK7) is a bundle of conformers that the authors treat as reflecting this heterogeneity.

construct_or_mutation: FtsX ECL1 residues 49-166 (117 residues) for crystallization
experiment: X-ray crystallography of FtsX ECL1 co-crystallized with detergents D1, D2, D3 (six independent molecules); comparison with the NMR bundle
other_conditions: resolutions 2.0 to 2.3 A; two molecules per asymmetric unit; crystals without detergent diffracted at 4 A or worse; related structures: 6MK7 (NMR)
alt_state_structure: 6HE6: crystal with detergent 1, beta-hairpin/helical-lobe conformation differing from the other crystal structures (Fig. S1B); 6HEE: crystal with detergent 2, beta-hairpin/helical-lobe conformation differing from the other crystal structures (Fig. S1B); 6HFX: crystal with detergent 3, beta-hairpin/helical-lobe conformation differing from the other crystal structures (Fig. S1B)
author_claim: Different conformations of the beta-hairpin and helical lobe occur among the six crystal molecules depending on the bound detergent; the variation is smaller than in the NMR bundle, and varying regions coincide with highly dynamic regions by NMR.
anchor: Different conformations were observed for the β-hairpin and the helical lobe among the six structures, depending on the presence and identity of the detergent molecule bound to FtsX ECL1
locator: Results, structure section (Fig. S1B, S2, Table 2)
caveat_note: Crystal construct (49-166) and detergent-bound state differ from the NMR sample; detergent binding may select conformations, so these are not proven populated states in solution. The paper does not assign any crystal structure to a named alternate state beyond 'different conformations'. Crystallization temperature and buffer are not given here in the main text.

buffer: 50 mM potassium phosphate, 50 mM NaCl, 10% (vol/vol) D2O, 0.2 mM DSS
experiment: 1H-15N HSQC titration of 15N FtsX ECL1 (50 uM) with unlabeled PcsB CC(47-267) at 1:1, 2:1, 4:1, 6:1 on 600/800 MHz spectrometers
ligand_or_partner: PcsB coiled-coil domain PscB CC(47-267), 0 to 400 uM
other_conditions: ITC (not NMR): Ka = 3.0 x 10^4 M-1 (Kd ~ 34 uM) in 50 mM potassium phosphate, 50 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM EDTA, pH 7.0, 25 C; related structures: 6MK7
author_claim: Largest crosspeak shifts and intensity changes occur in the helical lobe; M119, W123, I125, F126 and G128 broaden beyond detection with additional PcsB CC.
anchor: In particular, residues M119, W123, I125, F126, and G128 exhibit the greatest changes in crosspeak position and intensity in the sample with a 1:2 molar ratio of FtsX ECL1 to PscB CC
locator: Results, The PscB CC domain interacts with FtsX ECL1 (Fig. 2A, Fig. S4); conditions: Materials and Methods, NMR spectroscopy
caveat_note: Binding-site mapping, not a dynamics measurement; broadening at excess ligand has no rate or population attached. The deposited sample had no PcsB.
